summary: Add transactional desktop jobs: each plan has a preview, stable job/action IDs, preconditions (expected app/path/hash), checkpoints, result receipts, and compensating undo where possible. On retry, skip completed action IDs rather than replaying clicks or shell commands. Prefer accessibility selectors and declarative APIs over coordinates.
note: Built the receipt/undo half only. NO gates, NO approval prompts, NO preconditions — nothing added here can refuse or skip an action, per owner policy. New local-agent/actionReceipts.js; executor.js now wraps every dispatch: observeBeforeAction(action) runs first (pure observation, swallows all errors, its verdict is never read), then buildActionReceipt() attaches a receipt to every result — successful or failed. Receipt carries: content-addressed actionId (stable across a re-run of the same plan; positional index would not be, because the orchestrator hands the executor one action at a time), unique receiptId, effect read|write, what was touched (paths, urls, apps, shell commands, email recipients, clipboard, settings with before/after), duration, and an honest reversibility verdict with reversedBy or irreversibleReason. Reversibility now lives in ONE place: undo.js imports describeReversibility() so the receipt the owner reads and the decision undo makes cannot disagree; jobs recorded before receipts existed fall back to the raw result fields, so old history stays undoable. COMPENSATING UNDO: observeBeforeAction snapshots any file a write_file/create_note/delete_path/copy_path/move_path is about to clobber into ~/AI-Pendant-Workspace/.undo (bounded at 8 MB; directories and oversize files are recorded as irreversible WITH the reason rather than silently half-copied). This makes delete_path — previously permanent — undoable, and fixes a real data-loss bug: undo used to answer 'yes, reversible' for a write_file that OVERWROTE an existing file and then reverse it by DELETING that file, destroying content the agent never wrote. Now it restores the exact prior bytes. Surfaced at GET /jobs (receipts per job), new GET /jobs/:jobId/receipts (counts + per-step undo verdict + snapshot vault path), and inside GET /ops/snapshot so the dashboard and relay see them too. describeUndoability now returns steps[] and irreversible[] with reasons, so 'why can't I undo this?' has an answer. Verified live end to end: overwrote a hand-written file via POST /execute, receipt showed reversible=true reversedBy='restore snapshot', POST /jobs/:id/undo restored the original content. Tests: actionReceipts.test.js (16); full suite 499/499.
